decisions.reason: As a close-to-core upholstery fabric with an established presentation and low carrying cost, it still merits a place in the range and has not shown a clear enough negative signal to close the option.
Its flame-retardant contract-textile function fits the firm's hospitality and project strengths especially well, so the option remains strategically valuable and inexpensive to maintain.

After two seasons the niche semi-transparent wool bouclé leno fabric still looks weakly supported and less aligned with the firm's simplification and sustainability path, so its option value no longer justifies keeping it on the market.
This newly launched braided-structure fabric is still in the learning phase, and its dual upholstery-curtain use gives it enough core-market upside to keep the option open for another year.
